known_outcome: Determination (21 July 2023, s 188, §6.1, p.14): the original proposal in building consent BCO10340522 for a single common waste storage area did not provide reasonable access for the depositing of solid waste, and so did not comply with clause G15.3.1(b). The alternative-solution and carry-distance discussion is at pp.5-7 and p.12.
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies G15.3.1(b) and the reasonable-access test as the threshold, and separates depositing from collection.
Whether it explains what an alternative solution must show and treats the carry-distance evidence as the open item.
Whether it asks for the layout, distances and collection arrangement.
Whether it does not say the proposal complies.
